build_mocov3_head: build a MoCoV3Head with a predictor config, loss config, and temperature for contrastive pre-training
run_mocov3_loss: run the MoCoV3Head loss method with base_out and momentum_out tensors to compute contrastive loss
review_mocov3_head_init: review the MoCoV3Head constructor to understand how predictor and loss modules are built from config dicts
test_mocov3_head_loss: test the MoCoV3Head loss computation by passing normalized base and momentum encoder feature tensors
refactor_mocov3_temperature: refactor the MoCoV3Head to use a configurable temperature hyper-parameter for controlling distribution concentration
